name: materialize-3phase-workflow
description: Three-phase variant of materialize-intermediate-findings. Phase 1: Read first 3 logs, write error-analysis.md. Phase 2: Read remaining logs + deployments, write timeline-correlation.md. Phase 3: Read data files + Phase 1-2 artifacts, produce root-cause-report.md. Three phases enforce write cadence every ~4-5 ops, solving the gap problem that defeated the two-phase variant.
